title: Lamentatio Jeremie prophete (de Orto)
desc: Marbrianus de Orto, Lamentatio Jeremie prophete. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Ort2005); encoded by Jesse Rodin. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
